body:
genuine question, and we would like an actual answer: what is the first easter egg you ever caught yourself, before anyone told you it was there?

we ask because The Clue Web exists to hold them. thirty of them, grouped into seven trails you can pull one at a time — hidden messages, cryptic dates, and the payoffs they turned out to be pointing at.

three states, color-coded. clue planted. payoff revealed. and fan theory, still unconfirmed — which we mark as unconfirmed instead of quietly promoting it.

it opens under Threads on the site.

longlivets.com/?lens=easter-eggs&utm_source=instagram&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=symbol-thread

📷 the 2022 vmas — minutes after this was taken, she announced midnights. kevin mazur/getty images for mtv/paramount global. swipe for the clue web.
why: The Clue Web window opener (calendar ledger: Clue Web runs 08-17→21). PLATFORM SWAP, disclosed: the calendar put an era-deep-cut on folklore in this 23:00Z IG slot and symbol-thread in the 23:30Z X slot; those two are swapped here because no folklore image exists in the #1903 library and /eras/folklore.png is inside the last-10 posted Instagram window (posted 2026-08-04), so it would fail the media check. Both subjects still run today, on the platform each can actually be served on — the Clue Web takes the Instagram slot with a real library asset, folklore takes the X slot where media is not required. Hook "an honest question", and one we would genuinely like answered; replies stay human per growth charter rail 4. Facts read off the live Clue Web screenshot in #1903: 30 eggs, 7 trails, and the three-state legend (clue planted / payoff-reveal / fan theory unconfirmed), plus the thread’s own description of hidden messages, cryptic dates and their payoffs. DEPLOY DEPENDENCY: needs #1903 deployed. | 2026-08-12 Taylor-photo standard (issue #2031, Joey directive): attached a real credited photograph of Taylor from the repo corpus (apps/web/lib/longlive/lenses.ts), rehosted under /social/library/photos/. Campaign renamed to a STORY-UNIQUE value: findPostedDuplicate treats same platform+campaign as an already-posted duplicate, so the old thematic bucket campaigns (heartbeat:*) would have false-skipped every post in a bucket after its first one landed. Upgraded to a carousel: Taylor photo as the grid tile, the product screenshot as slide 2. | 2026-08-15 third-party image policy (docs/decisions.md): the Getty-sourced photo tile (taylor-midnights-vmas-2022.jpg) was removed from the library and dropped from this item's media; it now runs on the Clue Web screenshot alone, so mediaKind moved from "photo" to "site-screen" and the now-inapplicable mediaCredit/mediaSource were removed with it.
